0022600177.text: The Knicks (3-4, 2-2 at home) host the Bulls (1-6) in their eighth game of the season, with New York 3.5 games back in the Atlantic and eighth in the East, and winners of their last game. Josh Hart is out with an ankle injury, while Chicago is missing Nic Claxton (hamstring, out) and Jalen Smith (finger, day-to-day and a game-time decision). The teams have met once this season, with the Knicks winning 133-127 in Chicago on October 28, and the Knicks won the 2025-26 series 3-1.
